chars.YASSINE: YASSINE: a young Moroccan zellige craftsman wearing a dusty olive-green work shirt with rolled sleeves, beige work trousers with tile-dust stains, a small brown cap.
chars.NISRINE: NISRINE: a glamorous young woman wearing a tight bright red blazer over a black top, large gold hoop earrings, big black sunglasses pushed up on her bald head, a small white designer handbag.
chars.AMAL: AMAL: a sweet young woman wearing a soft pink long kaftan-style dress and a cream headscarf, holding a small beige purse.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a stylish Moroccan cafe terrace in a coastal city, NISRINE sits close to YASSINE and winks at him playfully while touching his arm; YASSINE sweats nervously and blushes, a small engagement ring visible on his finger, awkward comic tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: NISRINE walks confidently down a Moroccan seaside promenade like a model, hair-flip pose, while YASSINE stares at her with his jaw dropped and heart-struck, comic exaggerated amazement.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE stands on a scaffold in a riad courtyard full of colorful zellige tiles, holding a tile trowel, smirking slyly to himself as if planning something cheeky.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a fancy Moroccan restaurant, NISRINE happily orders a huge expensive seafood platter while YASSINE pulls a thick bundle of banknotes from an envelope, his face worried as the money disappears.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE proudly opens the door of a shiny rented car for NISRINE on a Moroccan city street at sunset, she steps in like a queen, he pretends to be rich.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: On a Moroccan beach corniche at night with city lights, YASSINE points at NISRINE and says something romantic with a charming grin, she laughs flattered holding a coffee cup.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Moroccan living room, AMAL smiles sweetly and shows YASSINE a wedding invitation sample, while YASSINE smiles fake and hides his phone behind his back, guilty eyes.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE sits alone on a rooftop terrace in a Moroccan medina at night, phone to his ear, grinning happily while calling, laundry lines and satellite dishes around.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In a quiet Moroccan cafe, NISRINE sits across from YASSINE with a very serious face, hands folded on the table, about to say something important; YASSINE freezes in shock, coffee cup halfway to his mouth.
